contentDecision.description: Eligible reviewers decide or policy managers advance expired deadlines.

publishingAuthority.title: Issue explicit Publishing Authority
publishingAuthority.description: Owners and admins grant a current member authority for one exact Channel; Workspace role never implies it.

publishingDecision.title: Inspect and decide Publishing Approval
publishingDecision.description: Requests originate from immutable publishing plans. Decisions additionally require explicit current per-Channel authority.

auditExport.title: Export audit evidence

region.title: Activate a Data Region Policy

retentionOperations.title: Holds and deletion receipts
retentionOperations.description: Create or release holds and request adapter-backed deletion with per-system outcomes.

safetyDecision.title: Record a Safety Decision
safetyDecision.description: Store a safe explanation and remediation without exposing detection internals.

safetyAppeal.title: Appeal an exact decision
safetyAppeal.description: An appeal applies only to the intent referenced by the Safety Decision.

safetyResolve.title: Resolve pending appeals
safetyResolve.description: Uphold the decision or queue current-policy revalidation of the exact intent.

bulkPreview.title: Preview a bounded Bulk Operation
bulkPreview.description: Dry-run exact targets and concurrency before any effect is queued.

bulkLifecycle.title: Operate durable bulk jobs
bulkLifecycle.description: Start, cancel, inspect outcomes, and retry only known-safe failures.

import.title: Verify and preview a signed import
import.description: Upload one signed Workspace package; unsupported security material is never imported.

workspaceExport.title: Request an encrypted Workspace Export
workspaceExport.description: Select portable configuration kinds and review the explicit signed-manifest omissions.

portfolios.noAuthority: Portfolio assignments are revocable navigation and coordination allowlists. Every command must still pin and authorize its target Workspace.

approval.separation: Creates a Publishing Approval policy requiring an eligible Approver distinct from the requester, with a one-hour deadline and one-day expiry.

bulk.previewFirst: Preview does not execute effects. Start remains a separate authorized command, and outcome-unknown items cannot be retried blindly.

portability.provenance: Upload the signed export package. The preview validates every digest and records whether each portable item is created, matched idempotently, or omitted with a reason. Security configuration and credentials are never materialized.
portability.itemsReady: {count} signed items are ready to verify.

retention.explanation: Deletion must explain immediate erasure, delayed erasure, legally retained evidence, active holds, deletion receipts, and tombstones.
